title: Slurry seal is like doing maintenance on your car
description:
Slurry seal is like giving our streets a tune‑up. Just as regular car maintenance helps the engine last longer, slurry seal helps extend the life of our roads without the cost of full reconstruction. 

Slurry seal provides a waterproof barrier that seals the asphalt by adding a fresh layer of highly textured aggregates that halt harmful oxidation. This cost-effective treatment keeps neighborhoods in good shape for years to come.

This work was recently completed on Cole Street in Clairemont.
